fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-10-18, around 13:35, an advance of Rs. 40,000 was collected from the complainant for an event catering booking near Mynthan Colony Main Street in Erode, after which the person became unreachable, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-10-30. The online submission was made by Arun Natarajan (9000000473). Suresh Selvam (9000000005), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. A person named Selvam Rajan, associated with the number 9000000157, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00012, as the mobile number 9000000157 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Advance allegedly collected for a service that was not provided.
